name: Venture firm
blurb: A venture firm's deals, portfolio, people and investment theses, with every signal tied to the beliefs it supports or contradicts.
about: An operating system for a venture firm that holds every belief behind a decision against the evidence for and against it. Deals, portfolio companies, people, meetings and theses are one record, so a thesis new evidence has weakened surfaces itself, a decision shows what it rested on, and a path to a founder runs through someone the team already knows. Agents capture calls, prepare briefs and propose lessons, and a partner reviews what they write before it joins the record.
sample: Quito Capital, a fictional AI-infrastructure fund

questions.q: Which active theses has new evidence contradicted?
Before investment committee, what contradicts the assumptions behind this deal?
Who on the team can get an introduction to this founder through someone they know?
What have the portfolio companies reported recently?
